description: 16,640 California block groups from the 1990 Census, with median income, housing age, room and occupancy averages, population, position and median house value. A test fixture: the train split of the gvlassis/california_housing re-upload on Hugging Face, which derives per-household averages from R. Kelley Pace and Ronald Barry's data as published through StatLib (20,640 block groups). Brightfield's tests read it; the shipped binary does not carry it.

licenses.title: No licence declared at source. The data is R. Kelley Pace and Ronald Barry's, issued through StatLib, whose submission terms provide for free distribution and non-commercial use and say nothing on commercial use.

name: california-housing

fields.description: Median household income for the district, in tens of thousands of 1990 US dollars.
fields.name: median_income

fields.description: Median age of the district's houses, in years.
fields.name: house_age

fields.description: Mean rooms per household. A district average, so values above ten are small households in large houses rather than errors.
fields.name: avg_rooms

fields.description: Mean bedrooms per household, on the same district-average basis.
fields.name: avg_bedrooms

fields.description: Number of people resident in the district.
fields.name: population

fields.description: District centroid latitude. With longitude, this is a map that needs no embedding behind it.
fields.name: latitude

fields.description: Median house value for the district, in hundreds of thousands of 1990 US dollars. Capped at 5.00001 in the source, which is a ceiling rather than a measurement.
fields.name: median_house_value
